title: Bread

source.name: Simple English Wikipedia — Bread
source.note: Chuyển thể sang mức A1 (câu ngắn, từ đơn giản); thông tin theo bài gốc.

paras: Bread is a food. Bread is made from flour and water. People usually add salt and yeast too. They bake bread in an oven. You can buy bread in many countries around the world.
You can make toast from bread. You can make sandwiches with bread. People also use bread to make other foods, like pizza. There are many different kinds of bread.
